digest.component_or_area: documentation and author guidance for file-impact scope contract
propositions: The tri-state file-impact contract (undeclared, paths, none) is implemented but documented incompletely across four reader-facing locations, creating an author discoverability gap
Three semantic states must be documented uniformly: undeclared (whole HEAD, unscoped), paths (dependency-scoped to declared files), and authenticated none (scoped empty set with substantive reason)
The event schema and gate documentation lack replacement and clearing semantics: paths clears reason, none clears prior paths, undeclared clears both

Public rebar explain plan must expose the tri-state contract, set-file-impact command, none workflow, and reason structure (why no repository files change; where output or evidence lives) to close the CLI discoverability gap
Documentation changes are scope=paths; the no-file-impact advisory criterion applies only to scope=none and requires a reason explaining both the deliverable and evidence location
